## Checklist

- [ ] `mvn -B verify` passes locally
- [ ] Behavior changes have tests (bug fixes: failing test and fix in one commit)
- [ ] No new runtime dependency in `jolt-core`

- [ ] Commits are atomic Conventional Commits
